title: Stained Glass Parisian View
description: A vibrant arched stained glass window frames a colorful Parisian street scene at sunset. The cobblestone street lined with shops and cafes leads toward the Sacré-Cœur Basilica under a glowing sun with radiating red rays, surrounded by iris and magnolia floral motifs.
prompt: Arched stained glass window overlooking a lively Parisian cobblestone street at sunset, colorful shops with bright awnings, people walking and sitting at cafes, the Sacré-Cœur Basilica visible in the distance, a large radiant sun with red rays in the sky, decorated with iris and magnolia flowers in the stained glass panels, vibrant colors, detailed lead lines
